name: Koufuku no Lalka
source:
"Welcome to Cafe Estacion."

A flower smiles up at the sky.
The sunshine that seems to melt everything.
The wind that carries unreachable wishes.
And the snow never melts.

In the midst of the changing seasons
They quietly weave their hearts together.
